presets.name: 原景角色精修
presets.description: 以人物、妆造与光影塑形为重点，原景局部整理并加入适合角色的克制氛围。
presets.prompt: Finish a polished, character-led cosplay portrait in the original location. Make expressive eyes, deliberate makeup, luminous skin highlights and costume colours the focus. Shape directional key light and soft fill across face, hands and clothes; preserve skin texture and the person's own skin tone. Keep rich shadow colour and distinct fabric, hair, wood and metal. Refine or locally replace distracting background details while retaining the room or outdoor layout and principal props. Use motivated atmospheric accents when useful and effects are allowed, with coherent reflected light and occlusion. Choose the mood from the outfit, character context and shot; keep background contrast and effect scale subordinate to the portrait. Honour explicit warm or coloured light and all user restrictions.

presets.name: 清透角色写真
presets.description: 明亮通透的肤质、精致眼妆与干净色彩，背景轻盈并衬托角色。
presets.prompt: Create an airy, polished cosplay character portrait in the existing setting. Use luminous skin with delicate shading, expressive eyes, preserved makeup colours and clean costume colour separation. Shape broad soft key light with gentle directional shadows and selective material highlights. Refine clutter, focus and tonal depth locally so the face leads and the setting remains recognizable. Give the portrait lightness and subtle stylization rather than flattening all tones or washing out skin. Add atmosphere only if it supports this character and shot.

presets.name: 舞台光角色写真
presets.description: 明确主光、精致妆造与有节制的舞台色光，背景和特效服务人物。
presets.prompt: Finish a character-focused cosplay photograph with sculpted stage-like key light in the existing location. Make the eyes, makeup and costume readable; balance clear portrait fill against selective coloured highlights. Shape a few motivated practical-light accents and coherent reflections on facing skin, cloth and metal. Keep the setting and main props recognizable and quieter than the performer. A beam or localized haze is optional when the scene supports it; avoid a full concert set or stacked spotlights unless requested.

presets.name: 暗调角色写真
presets.description: 深色环境、清晰眼神与有光泽的肤质，保留服装色彩和暗部层次。
presets.prompt: Finish a polished low-key cosplay portrait with expressive eyes, luminous skin highlights and dimensional dark clothing. Develop a character-appropriate palette from this outfit and the existing location. Shape facial key light and controlled fill before adding environmental accents; retain lip colour, material hue and coherent hand/arm lighting. Use selective shadow and focus to simplify the background while keeping its layout recognizable. Night mood comes from tonal structure and motivated light, with optional restrained atmosphere; avoid turning every surface grey, blue or murky.

presets.name: 柔和人像精修
presets.description: 皮肤和妆造精修、干净背景与柔和主光，保留本人和自然摄影质感。
presets.prompt: Deliver a finished, restrained cosplay portrait with skin and deliberate makeup refined through soft directional light and continuous colour transitions. Retain pores, lip pigment, contact-lens patterns and natural facial asymmetry. Clean distracting surroundings and refine background depth and tonal hierarchy so the face leads. Keep skin, hair and fabric within the same illumination; this portrait style requires no added fantasy particles or beams.

presets.name: 逆光氛围写真
presets.description: 人物主光与选择性逆光共同塑形，背景留出呼吸感并保留妆造细节。
presets.prompt: Finish a luminous cosplay portrait with a motivated backlight or side-back accent within the existing setting. Shape a flattering facial key and controlled fill; retain expressive eyes, lip colour, rich costume hues and natural skin transitions. Place selective highlights on facing hair and material surfaces without tracing every strand or creating a glowing outline. Refine background contrast, focus and source bloom locally. Keep atmosphere selective and the person visually dominant rather than flooding the scene with rays or haze.

presets.name: 幻想角色写真
presets.description: 精致人物与角色意象相呼应，局部幻想特效融入原场景。
presets.prompt: Finish a polished fantasy cosplay portrait grounded in the visible outfit and supplied character context. First refine the face, makeup, costume colours and sculpted light. Develop a compatible visual motif within the existing setting, preserving its location, perspective and major props. When an effect helps, place a restrained character-appropriate accent beside or behind the person with real depth, coherent reflections and occlusion; suggest the story without inventing unsupported abilities. Skin and eyes stay clear, background detail and effect brightness remain subordinate, and fantasy need not mean a luminous particle field or a replacement world.

presets.name: 民俗仪式写真
presets.description: 以眼神、妆造和材质衬托民俗叙事，原景局部营造含蓄仪式氛围。
presets.prompt: Finish a refined, character-led ritual or folklore cosplay portrait within the existing location. Let expression, deliberate makeup, costume colour and tactile materials carry the story. Build a clear portrait key and selective environment light, with rich shadows and luminous skin even for an eerie concept. Rework distracting background details locally while retaining architecture, major props and perspective. Choose a restrained atmosphere or symbolic accent from visible storytelling objects and supplied context when useful. Keep mystery in selective shadow, depth and visual suggestion; avoid crowded new shrines, walls of symbols, dense fog or supernatural spectacle unless requested.
